textBox.richText: Catherine and Matthew - The Craftwood Inn

Words cannot express the gratitude we have towards you. You were simply flawless in your presentation and were constantly checking in on me throughout the whole wedding planning process. When I had kooky ideas such as my "dove ceremony", you became so excited and created the most amazing, heartfelt, & memorable reading. It was our pleasure to have you a part of the most special day in our lives. Thank you so much!!!!
